articles.title: Ludhiana: Medicine shortage continues to plague govt ayurvedic dispensaries
articles.description: Dr Raman Khanna, district ayurveda and Unani officer, who is also holding the additional charge of director ayurveda, Punjab, said the department had floated a tender for procurement of medicines in August 2025, but it had to be cancelled due to technical reasons

articles.title: "Tender permits 5-story commercial complex": Tejasvi Surya leads protest against land acquisition at Bengaluru's Lalbagh
articles.description: Bengaluru South MP Tejasvi Surya on Sunday spearheaded a protest at the iconic Lalbagh Botanical Garden, distributing posters and leaflets with the tagline "Lalbagh is for sale" to voice his opposition against the Karnataka state government's proposal to acquire over five acres of the park's land for a tunnel road project.

articles.title: Fire and Rescue officer killed after fire tender crashes into four vehicles in Erumely
articles.description: A fire tender lost control near Erumely, crashing into four vehicles, killing one officer and injuring two.
